heading: How learning works at NeuroEd Lab
body: Learning programmes at NeuroEd Lab are guided by principles that support both academic growth and personal development.

pillars.title: Personalised Learning Design
pillars.description: Each child follows a learning pathway designed around their interests, strengths, and stage of development.

pillars.title: Brain-Based Learning
pillars.description: Learning strategies draw on neuroscience and cognitive science to support how children naturally learn best.

pillars.title: Project-Based Learning
pillars.description: Ideas are explored through discussion, projects, and real-world connections that make learning meaningful.

pillars.title: Holistic Development
pillars.description: Alongside academics, children build confidence, communication skills, curiosity, and independence.
